description: Send a WeCom app message to employees as the company's self-built app. SENDS to real people — it goes through the permission gate like send_mattermost_message. Required: content and at least one of user_ids (WeCom UserIDs, from list_wecom_contacts) or department_ids. msgtype 'text' (default) or 'markdown' (markdown only renders in the WeCom client). Max 2048 bytes — longer content is rejected rather than silently cut off by WeCom. '@all' is refused; use department 1 explicitly. dry_run: true validates and shows the request without sending. Recipients WeCom could not reach are reported back (invalid_users …).

content.description: Message text, max 2048 bytes (about 680 Chinese characters).

department_ids.description: Department ids; every member receives it (max 100).

dry_run.description: Only validate and show what would be sent; send nothing.

name: send_wecom_message
